title: Crestline Fleet Account Past-Due Balance and Late Charge Computation
content:
**Clause.** On a Crestline Fleet Account, the late charge for a statement month is assessed on the last day of that month, and every date test in this rule counts from the day the charge is assessed: the past-due balance is every invoice whose due date is before that day, leaving out an invoice whose due date is 240 whole months or more before it, plus every late charge already assessed, less every remittance, early-pay discount and credit memo applied to the account, and less the amounts under open dispute, never below 0.00; the charge is the late-charge rate in percent of the balance the rate applies to, rounded half up to the cent, and never less than the program's smallest late charge when any past-due balance exists. The balance the rate applies to is the whole past-due balance, and the late-charge rate is the program's monthly late-charge percent.

## Parts of the past-due balance

| Part | Taken as |
|---|---|
| invoices | the invoice amounts of every invoice whose due date is before the day the charge is assessed, leaving out any invoice whose due date is 240 whole months or more before that day |
| late charges | every late charge already assessed on the account |
| less remittances, early-pay discounts and credit memos | every such entry applied to the account, whichever invoice it was applied to |
| less amounts under open dispute | the disputed amounts of every open dispute on the account |
| floor | the result is never below 0.00 |

A program whose monthly late-charge percent is 0 charges nothing. When the past-due balance is 0.00, nothing is charged.

## Worked figures (hypothetical account, program rate of 2 percent, smallest late charge 5.00)

1. Invoices due before the day the charge is assessed: 3000.00; late charges already assessed: 0.00.
2. Remittances 1200.00, early-pay discounts 0.00, credit memos 100.00 applied to the account; open disputes 260.00.
3. Past-due balance: 3000.00 less 1200.00, less 100.00, less 260.00, that is 1440.00.
4. Charge: 2 percent of 1440.00 is 28.80, above the 5.00 floor: 28.80.

With a past-due balance of 180.00 instead, 2 percent is 3.60, so the charge is the smallest late charge of 5.00.
